metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Vada Chennai
metas.description: A young carrom player in north Chennai becomes a reluctant participant in a war between two warring gangsters.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Fjord
metas.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Ranabaali
metas.description: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

metas.name: ★ 9.4 · 2026 · Wanted
metas.description: Hyun-jun, an ordinary postman, is mistakenly arrested as a wanted criminal due to his identical appearance to fugitive Choi Cheol-gu. While struggling to prove his innocence, the real Cheol-gu escapes prison and flees to Taiwan. When Hyun-jun travels there on a reward trip, he is once again mistaken for the criminal and even kidnapped, only to be rescued by tough detective Woo-hee and her partner. As repeated mix-ups lead to comedic chaos, Hyun-jun and Woo-hee grow closer and ultimately team up to catch the real fugitive together.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Leaving North Korea
metas.description: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2025 · No Parking
metas.description: After a tense parking dispute, Yeon-hee clashes with a mysterious man-only to learn he's a serial killer. Now targeted, she must escape his deadly grip and survive a nightmare that began with one badly parked car.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · The Informant
metas.description: Tae-bong, an informant in a smuggling operation, gets exposed during his mission. Meanwhile, bumbling detective Nam-hyuk stumbles into the chaos while attempting his own scheme. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two must recover their losses and take down the criminals.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Buddy
metas.description: A brave girl and her friends must escape a kids television show.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
metas.description: See an extended look at "Grand Theft Auto VI", the next evolution in the groundbreaking "Grand Theft Auto" series.

metas.name: 2026 · The Last Sunrise
metas.description: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · It Ends
metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: 2026 · Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
metas.description: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: ★ 4.3 · 2026 · V/H/S/Mixtape
metas.description: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

metas.name: 2026 · Doing Life
metas.description: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

metas.name: 2026 · Coven Academy
metas.description: Teen witch apprentices band together to defend New Orleans against an approaching dark force.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Therapy Done Right
metas.description: A renowned psychoanalyst, disillusioned with traditional therapy, begins to secretly intervene in his patients' lives, achieving remarkable results - until a creatively blocked writer enters his practice.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2026 · The Storm
metas.description: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be tra...

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Pennum Porattum
metas.description: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

metas.name: ★ 9.3 · 2026 · You Can See Everything
metas.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait becomes a mind-bending three-year journey.

metas.name: 2026 · Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Street Fighter
metas.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

metas.name: 2026 · Love of Your Life
metas.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

metas.name: ★ 9.2 · 2026 · Comrade Kalyan
metas.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

metas.name: 2026 · Mayookha
metas.description: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1990 · Everybody's Fine
metas.description: Matteo decides to take a trip across Italy to go visiting his five children.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2014 · The Guest
metas.description: A soldier introduces himself to the Peterson family, claiming to be a friend of their son who died in action. After the young man is welcomed into their home, a series of accidental deaths seem to be connected to his presence.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · Jailer 2
metas.description: A retired officer's peaceful life is disrupted when a dangerous criminal organization threatens his family. He must use his skills one final time to protect his loved ones and preserve his legacy.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Dhoomakethu
metas.description: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2010 · Yogi Bear

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1986 · Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
metas.description: Arriving in Chicago, Henry moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Aasha
metas.description: A stubborn, short-tempered woman named Aasha gets into an altercation with Jeemon over a road accident. She is resolved to pursue a case against him, while he threatens her with serious consequences.

metas.name: 2020 · The Weight
metas.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2014 · The Other Woman
metas.description: After discovering that her boyfriend is married, Carly meets the wife he's been betraying; when yet another affair is discovered, all three women team up to plot revenge on the three-timing S.O.B.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2019 · The Art of Racing in the Rain
metas.description: Through his bond with his owner, aspiring Formula One race car driver Denny, golden retriever Enzo learns that the techniques needed on the racetrack can also be used to successfully navigate the journey of life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2010 · Confessions
metas.description: Yuko, a teacher of middle-school, is shattered to see her four-year-old daughter dead. She returns back to the school and finds out that her students are responsible for her daughter's murder.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Spa
metas.description: The narrative follows the intertwined lives of people connected to La Paradise, an urban massage therapy centre. It centres on Mathan, a man struggling to distinguish between the reality of love and its fictionalised ideals. Through a sharp lens of social satire, the story explores adult themes and human behaviour within this unique urban setting.
